conservative_interpretation: The projected cost target is a52.468% reduction in F+S with all other terms fixed; the original frozen cost equation and historical maxima are not replaced by favorable synthetic medians.
Profiling can falsify an optimization rationale or locate repeated work; it cannot establish a new historical runtime guarantee.

A tiny-support result can establish correctness/small-shape cost only. A matched support count still does not reproduce actual weights, covariance, solver conditioning, tail probabilities or future support growth.
Empirical insertion, dense-grid/FFT work, tail checks and marginal CDF work have different shape dependence; retain complete-call timings alongside any proposed kernel speedup.

control.purpose: Three-atom control with the same score extent, avoiding the confound of a naturally tiny dense grid.

minimal_fixed_profile_design.optional_scaling_case: Only if the two cases do not resolve scaling:1024 pairs on axes0,2,...62 with the same fixed weight rule; label as sensitivity rather than observed historical coverage.
minimal_fixed_profile_design.record: Exact empirical count, actual primary/doubled grid dimensions, fit iterations, separate complete fit/score wall time and within-call attribution. Do not change means or support to force a favorable grid size after seeing timings.

representative.purpose: Near actual685/693 atom count, symmetric0..62 support and background mean near22; shape is deliberately synthetic and contains no historical score pairs or weights.
representative.support: All676 pairs (floor(62*i/25), floor(62*j/25)) for integer i,j in0..25.
representative.weights: Positive deterministic weights proportional to exp(-((h-22)^2+(a-22)^2)/200).

question_answer: A tiny three-atom fixture cannot rule out empirical grid insertion as a bottleneck. The frozen grid method has a Python loop over every atom and is invoked twice by double-grid scoring. The actual maxima each use roughly230 times as many atoms, and tiny low-rate fixtures may additionally use much smaller dense grids.
scope: Saved support-size metadata and synthetic fixture source review only. No distribution recovery, fit, scoring or profiling performed.
